archetypes.name: claude-cli-flag-contract
archetypes.rationale: Verifies that the claude --print flags the plan claims are supported (--add-dir, --allowedTools, --permission-mode) actually exist in the installed CLI before launch-claude-subprocess.sh adds --read-tools, since flag-unavailability failures produce silent zero-archetype outcomes rather than visible errors.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read scripts/launch-claude-subprocess.sh lines 25-44 and confirm its arg parser currently rejects --read-tools, --add-dir, and --allowedTools as unknown options (exit 2), then verify the plan's proposed changes add these flags to both the parser and the downstream claude invocation. Check .claude/rules/verify-external-tool-invocations.md to confirm it requires running the exact added invocation (claude --print --add-dir ... --allowedTools ...) on the dev machine before commit; cross-check whether the plan specifies the concrete --permission-mode value to use or defers it to an adjacent comment — if deferred, note that no harness can validate a placeholder. Read scripts/test-launch-claude-subprocess.sh and check whether it stubs the claude binary or exercises live argv so you can determine whether the test coverage gap for the new --read-tools path is covered by a stub or requires a real CLI to be present. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: presence-flag-caller-scope
archetypes.rationale: Checks that CODEX_AVAILABLE/CURSOR_AVAILABLE are actually in scope at the three scout call sites the plan threads them through; a missing or empty binding silently passes --codex-present '' and the waterfall stays Claude-only with no error.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read skills/review/scripts/dispatch-panel.sh around line 327 and trace how CODEX_AVAILABLE and CURSOR_AVAILABLE reach that call site — whether they come from argv parsing earlier in the script, from environment, or from a sourced env file. Read skills/design/scripts/plan-review-loop.sh lines 660-680 and verify that CODEX_PRESENT and CURSOR_PRESENT are bound variables in _run_plan_review_round's scope at the scout invocation (line 666), not relying on ambient export from an outer call frame that may not be set in test harness contexts. Read skills/design/scripts/scout-plan-archetypes-wrapper.sh to confirm it both accepts --codex-present/--cursor-present and propagates them into SCOUT_ARGS, since that is the second hop on the plan-review-loop path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
